name: Perception Studio
tagline: Modular synth DAW, VST3 plug-in & host, and hardware synth factory.
description: Perception Studio: modular synth DAW, VST3 plug-in and host (patch third-party VST3s as modules), granular and spectral engines, mathematically proven DSP, and hardware synth factory.

tutorials.title: 16-voice granular clouds & formant-preserving FFT pitch
tutorials.summary: Load a 48 kHz WAV into grainCloud, sweep reverse playback rate and jitter, and blend a fifth with the spectral pitch shifter.

tutorials.title: Drop Perception Studio into Ableton & Reaper as a VST3
tutorials.summary: Load Perception as an instrument or effect plug-in, map macro controls, and flash the exact same patch to a hardware pedal profile.

posts.title: Unlimited Signal Routing: Tapping Any Outlet Into Any Bus
posts.alt: Dark indigo modular synth patch bay with glowing orange signal cables and lavender modulation arcs

posts.alt: Precision dark indigo oscilloscope grid with cyan harmonic spectra and glowing orange traveling wave curves
posts.summary: From allpass unit magnitude to weighted overlap-add and antiderivative anti-aliasing: every core formula carries a Lean proof that fails if mutated.

instruments.summary: Per-note modular DSP graph with Constant, Pitched, and Struck followers.
instruments.controls: Unlimited nodes & cables · attack · release · VST3 nodes
instruments.ports: MIDI In → Arbitrary DSP Graph → Mono / Stereo Out + Parallel Bus Sends
instruments.details: Wire any of Perception Studio's 37+ typed DSP components and isolated VST3 workers into a per-note signal graph. Parameters can hold constant values, track note frequency (Pitched), or scale with velocity (Struck).

instruments.summary: 16-voice stereo granular instrument with WAV import, freeze, and reverse.
instruments.controls: position · rate (-4×..4×) · duration · pan · onset · jitter
instruments.ports: WAV Source (8–192 kHz, ≤ 8 MiB) → Stereo Out
instruments.details: Imports little-endian RIFF/WAVE files (8/16/24/32-bit PCM or float32), averages to mono with middle C root, and spawns up to 16 overlapping grains. Zero rate freezes position; negative rate plays in reverse.

instruments.summary: Formant-preserving FFT pitch shifter and two-source spectral morphing.
instruments.ports: Audio In (+ Side Source) → Spectral STFT → Audio Out
instruments.details: Backed by Lean-verified weighted overlap-add and radix-2 FFT proofs. Shifts pitch while preserving vocal and metallic formants, or freezes the final spectrum of a phrase to sustain it at new pitches.

instruments.summary: Waveguide string excited by a single-period noise burst, damped on release.
instruments.details: Models a plucked string with a fractional-delay waveguide backed by travelingWavePropagation. Released notes damp cleanly to a 0.12 s decay and ring 0.3 s past the gate.

instruments.summary: Bowed string model with gated bow velocity and fading 5.4 Hz vibrato.
instruments.details: Continuous stick-slip physical string with 80 ms attack / 100 ms release bow velocity envelopes and natural 5.4 Hz vibrato fade-in.

instruments.summary: Eight coupled modal resonators tuned to harmonic bell ratios.
instruments.details: Single-impulse excitation driving eight resonant bell modes that ring naturally for the full decay duration regardless of note gate length.

instruments.summary: Eight bar-mode resonators for marimba, vibraphone, and metallic percussion.
instruments.details: Tuned to physical bar-mode overtone ratios for wooden marimba, metallic vibraphone, and percussive chimes.

instruments.summary: Dual detuned phase-distortion operators with smooth sine bloom.
instruments.controls: breakpoint · feedback · attack · release · bloom · detune
instruments.details: Two phase-distortion oscillators detuned symmetrically in cents whose breakpoint eases smoothly toward a pure sine over the bloom duration.

instruments.summary: Pitch-swept sine body layered with a coloured noise burst.
instruments.details: Combines a pitch-dropping sine sub body with a filterable noise burst (0 = white, 1 = dark) for tight kicks, snares, and percussive hits.
